options.name: job_id
options.description: The job id that has been assigned to the job. A job id must begin with `STC`, `JOB`, `TSU` and are followed by up to 5 digits. When a job id is greater than 99,999, the job id format will begin with `S`, `J`, `T` and are followed by 7 digits. The I(job_id) can contain include multiple wildcards. The asterisk (`*`) wildcard will match zero or more specified characters.

options.name: job_name
options.description: The job name to query. A job name can be up to 8 characters long. The I(job_name) can contain include multiple wildcards. The asterisk (`*`) wildcard will match zero or more specified characters. Note that using this value will query the system for '*' and then return just matching values. This may lead to security issues if there are read-access limitations on some users or jobs.

options.name: owner
options.description: Identifies the owner of the job. If no owner is set, the default set is 'none' and all jobs will be queried.
